'''Ballistakinesis''' was a [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]], which used telekinesis to accelerate a handful of small objects to lethal velocities. Ballistakinesis was not especially accurate, but when blanketing an area with accelerated debris, accuracy was not essential. Evasion was possible, but difficult.
